args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! I'm Emma Johnson, and I'm so excited to have you joining our team in the marketing department.

I've heard great things about your experience in digital marketing, content creation, and social media management, and I'm looking forward to working with you and learning from your expertise.

If there's anything you need as you settle in, please don't hesitate to reach out. I'd be happy to help you get acquainted with the team or answer any questions you may have.

Looking forward to meeting you soon!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
